summary: Full frontend e2e testing of DukanSaathi demo-mode app. All 11 requested flows validated including the CRITICAL confirm-before-commit invariant. All state mutations (stock, udhari, expenses, products, transfers) correctly gated behind draft confirmation. Math on sale flow (grand total ₹5,310, udhari ₹2,310) matches spec. Only minor console warnings found (a11y/hydration).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. NewBill.jsx line 116 renders each option's label wrapped in an instrumentation <span>. Cosmetic — options still function — but produces console error on every render.
Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — a11y warning in console; wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add <DialogTitle>.

action_items: (Low) Remove instrumentation <span> wrapper inside <option> children in NewBill.jsx gst-rate select to silence hydration error.
(Low) Add a <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden title) inside BillPreviewModal and the transfer/product form dialogs to satisfy Radix a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: commitDraft() in AppContext.jsx is the single write-path — good separation. Confirm-before-commit invariant verified by inspecting localStorage between preview open and confirm click: NO mutation occurred until draft-confirm-btn was pressed for sale/payment/return/expense/transfer/product_save.
Sale math verified against calc.js: base 10 × ₹450 = ₹4,500 + 18% GST ₹810 = ₹5,310; cash ₹3,000 → udhari ₹2,310 correctly attributed to Ashok Kumar (12,500 → 14,810).
Returns to godown (godownQty +5) is a reasonable default but consider surfacing the destination bin (showroom vs godown) in the return draft card for clarity.
test_credentials: Demo login via data-testid='demo-login-btn' — no email/password.
seed_data_creation: None beyond the app's own auto-seed (Ashok Kumar 12500, Suresh 3200, 7 products incl. 2130 Highlight, seeded invoices). During testing added: 1 TEST_Tile_A product, 1 sale invoice, 1 payment (-500 Ashok), 1 return (2130 +5 godown), 1 expense (250), 1 transfer (p1 show+10/god-10). Data is per-browser localStorage; no cleanup required in preview env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is client-side only (localStorage key: dukansaathi_demo-shop). To verify writes, read/parse this key before and after actions. Sale/payment/return/expense/transfer/product_save all route through commitDraft in AppContext.jsx and require an explicit *-confirm-btn click. PDF preview iframe renders blank in headless Chromium — expected. Voice mic FAB (data-testid=voice-mic-button) renders but Web Speech API is unavailable in headless — do not attempt live mic tests.
